description: Trigger a Beacon daily report — runs the 6-dimension checkup, renders a short IM-style push (60-200 chars), and updates last_report_at as a side-effect. Use this for the daily report SAFE rule (PRD V2.1 §8.3, BeaconScheduler 9:00 cron) or when the user asks 'show me today's report'. Default trigger='manual'.

push_time.description: Push 时间 (5 个固定 slot) 用于跟 user 设置对账. Default 09:00.

trigger.description: 触发来源 — manual (用户/agent 主动) / cron (BeaconScheduler 定时器). Default manual.

name: skillfm_send_daily_report
